packageRules.description: slicc-browsers ships one release to npm and as a Go module, and the guard harness requires both pins to name the same release: move @ai-ecoverse/slicc-browsers and github.com/ai-ecoverse/slicc-browsers in one PR. A major also moves the Go pin to its /vN module path (the preset's gomodUpdateImportPaths), and the harness's module-path check then fails it until the harness names the new path, so a major never automerges.
